# SanjanaIAS

> 100% Free, daily, syllabus-mapped current affairs for UPSC, IAS, IPS, and government exam preparation.

SanjanaIAS is an independent educational platform providing current affairs analysis, AI-powered tutoring, and practice questions. Content covers World, India, and Telangana news, mapped directly to the UPSC syllabus.

## Core Study Material
- [Daily Overview](https://sanjanaias.vercel.app/dashboard): The main dashboard with today's most important topics.
- [Prelims Practice](https://sanjanaias.vercel.app/prelims): Take unlimited quizzes with MCQs on current affairs.
- [Mains Practice](https://sanjanaias.vercel.app/mains): Practice answer writing with model structures.
- [Syllabus Explorer](https://sanjanaias.vercel.app/syllabus): Browse current affairs mapped to GS Papers I-IV.

## AI Tutor
- [Sanjana AI Tutor](https://sanjanaias.vercel.app/ai-tutor): Ask questions and get answers grounded in our library of topics.

## Exam Regions
- [World Affairs](https://sanjanaias.vercel.app/world): International relations and global events.
- [India Affairs](https://sanjanaias.vercel.app/india): National policy, economy, and governance.
- [Telangana Affairs](https://sanjanaias.vercel.app/telangana): State-level current affairs.

## Optional
- [Privacy Policy](https://sanjanaias.vercel.app/privacy.html): How we handle your data.
